divergences.description: Spec 7-1's Design Notes say the 2s poll has no client timeout. The cubit gives up instead: after 5 consecutive getStatus failures it cancels the timer and emits the terminal Erro state. The plan's Suggested Review Order records this as a review patch.

The diff sets the whole app's locale to pt_BR (locale, localization delegates, supportedLocales limited to pt_BR) in main.dart, so showDateRangePicker renders in Portuguese. No execution task asked for this; it is recorded as a review patch in the Review Findings and Suggested Review Order.

Spec 7-2's Code Map specifies a `Failure? lastDownloadFailure` field on the cubit, read by the sheet's `_handleDownload`. Instead, downloadPdf/downloadRawData return `Future<Failure?>` and the widget reads that return value; no such field exists. The Suggested Review Order records this change.

Spec 7-1 asks for create-time dates sent as-is. The diff normalizes periodStart to local start-of-day and pushes periodEnd to local end-of-day (23:59:59.999) before converting to UTC, which changes the request payload sent to the backend. The Suggested Review Order records this as a review patch.

Downloads are guarded per format with an in-flight set, and a download that is already running is no longer cancelled when the cubit closes, so dismissing the sheet mid-download still opens the file. Neither behavior is in the original spec 7-2 Code Map; both are recorded in its Review Findings.
